name: quota-tracker
description: Track Claude Code quota usage via Anthropic API rate limit headers (credential proxy) or, without the proxy, Claude Code's own status line rate_limits and StopFailure rate_limit hook. Shows 5h and 7d utilization, reset times, and quota status. Config: QUOTA_STATUSLINE_ENABLED (default true) installs the status line recorder and StopFailure hook in every Claude session's config dir at launch, and false removes them; QUOTA_STATUSLINE_PASSTHROUGH names a status line command to show instead of the short line (unset: the one the installer replaced).
